scale.10: Excellent routing with short electrical loops, coherent ground reference and practical service access

scope: Whole-board routing quality assessment from the debug/ADC service role; not a rating of TPG6 alone or manufacturing sign-off.
confidence: High for scoped debug geometry and source ownership, medium for whole-board quality; global physical continuity, shorts and footprint preservation are independently validated.
reasons: Generated compensation/eFuse loop changes shorten sensitive paths and the whole board carries less routed signal copper on the main ground layer.
Debug access improves measurably: the worst filtered-ADC distance to a physical ground probe falls by 49.36%, while all 8 LEDs, 26 probes and 13 actual debug paths remain.

The moved probe retains a short authentic ground return and native plane contact, with 0.225 mm clearance from the full barrel drill to the nearest exposed SMT mask; the corrected native label is present.
remainingLimitations: More than 430 full vias and substantial inner1 signal routing remain; total route simplification is modest.
TP07/TP08/TP09 filtered probe chains still span approximately 11.70/11.79/12.49 mm with existing transfers, and the I2C row still lacks equally close ground access.
Long indicator, fan and UART routes limit service and routing quality.
No bench noise measurement or 3D probe-body verification was performed.
acceptanceDependency: Use final frozen-hash graph, shorts, part/footprint and silkscreen-mask validator receipts for overall acceptance.
